Hi Jane / Amit / Tom —

Great — appreciate the rapid reply. Per Jane's ask, attaching a short POC-scope doc and a concise security snapshot with SOC 2 + encryption points that typically address first-pass questions. Links to full evidence can be provided on request.

POC logistics we recommend: 
- Duration: 4 weeks (config + pilot + evaluation)
- Success criteria (example): 1) end-to-end integration with prior-auth data feed, 2) throughput at 95th percentile meeting ~200ms per request for pilot subset, 3) quality measured by X% reduction in manual triage (we can co-define).
- Roles: Product sponsor, Procurement signatory (Amit), Technical reviewer (Tom), Customer Success owner (Monica)

Priyom and Monica will handle technical kickoff and onboarding. Laura is on security and will stand up the items your reviewers ask for (SOC 2 control list, encryption-at-rest, key management, logging/audit exports).

If helpful, we can schedule a 20‑minute procurement + finance call with Amit this week to run through common commercial terms and our standard POC agreement. Do any times on Wednesday look good for you?

Attachments: Redwood-POC-scope-v1.pdf (PDF stub), Redwood-security-snapshot.txt (text stub)
